description: This file manages file system watchers for skill files (SKILL.md) in a project, using chokidar to monitor changes and trigger snapshot updates.

classes.name: SkillsWatchState
classes.description: Represents the state of a file system watcher monitoring skill files, including the watcher instance, path key, debounce time, and pending change.

methods.name: resolveWatchPaths
methods.description: Resolves the list of directory paths to watch for skill file changes based on workspace directory and configuration.

methods.name: toWatchGlobRoot
methods.description: Normalizes a directory path for glob pattern matching, converting Windows separators to POSIX style.

methods.name: resolveWatchTargets
methods.description: Generates a list of SKILL.md file paths to watch based on project structure.

methods.name: ensureSkillsWatcher
methods.description: Sets up or updates a file system watcher for skill files in a specified workspace, with debounce and error handling.

methods.name: resetSkillsRefreshForTest
methods.description: Resets the watcher state for testing purposes, closing all active watchers.
